name: Report Back to Fizzlebub

meta.previous: Get the Gnomes Drunk, Get the Goblins Drunk

summary: Kravel Koalbeard reports that the Fool's Stout worked and sends you to Booty Bay with news for Crank Fizzlebub. He has bet on the next race and hopes the pit crew you made drunk wrecked their own car. This follows your choice to make one pit crew drunk.

sections.title: A Note for Crank
sections.body: Kravel Koalbeard says the Fool's Stout worked well. He's bet on the next race and hopes the pit crew you made drunk wrecked their own car. Take his note about the successful test to Crank Fizzlebub in Booty Bay. Crank will want the news, and Kravel hopes to get more stout for future races.

sections.title: Crank's Answer
sections.body: Crank Fizzlebub reads Kravel's note and calls the test a success. Glad to hear it, Crank says to ask whenever you want more stout. Then you'll be set to collect more of Zanzil's Mixture.

aliases: who gives report back to fizzlebub
faq.answer: Kravel Koalbeard, the dwarf at the Mirage Raceway on the Shimmering Flats in Thousand Needles, gives you the note.
Crank Fizzlebub is in Booty Bay.
Before this, you completed Get the Gnomes Drunk or, if you chose the other crew, Get the Goblins Drunk.

faq.q: What does Kravel Koalbeard want Fizzlebub to know?
faq.answer: Kravel Koalbeard wants Fizzlebub to know the test succeeded.
